name: dynamodb-ecommerce-learning
description: NestJS e-commerce MVP for learning DynamoDB with LocalStack

scripts.sam:deploy:local: samlocal deploy --stack-name dynamodb-learning-lambdas-local --resolve-s3 --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --region ap-southeast-1 --parameter-overrides ProductsTableName=products DynamoDbEndpoint=http://localhost.localstack.cloud:4566 AwsRegion=ap-southeast-1 AwsAccessKeyId=test AwsSecretAccessKey=test
scripts.sam:invoke:create: aws lambda invoke --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name CreateProductFunction --payload fileb://events/create-product.json lambda-response-create.json
scripts.sam:invoke:list: aws lambda invoke --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name ListProductsFunction --payload fileb://events/list-products.json lambda-response-list.json
scripts.sam:invoke:get: aws lambda invoke --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name GetProductFunction --payload fileb://events/get-product.json lambda-response-get.json
scripts.sam:invoke:update: aws lambda invoke --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name UpdateProductFunction --payload fileb://events/update-product.json lambda-response-update.json
scripts.sam:invoke:delete: aws lambda invoke --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --region ap-southeast-1 --function-name DeleteProductFunction --payload fileb://events/delete-product.json lambda-response-delete.json
